text:
Alex (Sales): heads-up — CoreFin wants us to onboard PantherA-7B and pin v1.2.0 for them in EU + India. They want hosted API + an on-prem option later. Legal said license looks permissive but asked we confirm tokenization behavior. shared intake: https://redwood.example/ intake/COREFIN-PA7B :eyes:
Maya (PM): thanks. can you paste the intake form here? we need the customer-provided model artifacts or a model-hub link, sample prompts, and target SLOs. also what timeline are they asking for?
Alex (Sales): pasted below. timeline: pilot in 4 weeks, GA in ~8 wks if no blockers. model link: https://models.openrepo.org/panthera/panthera-7b-v1.2.0.tar.gz. they want EU + IN availability first.
Debbie (Catalog): quick checklist: 1) confirm license + weights checksum, 2) tokenizer file, 3) quantization compatibility notes, 4) security scanning. Alex do we have the checksum?
Alex (Sales): they provided sha256 in the intake: `d3b07384d113edec49eaa6238ad5ff00ca1a`. attached sample prompts and eval set in the intake.
Ronan (Eng): first pass: PantherA uses a nonstandard tokenizer (bytepair variant). before pinning we need to validate tokenization parity with our tokenizer infra. Also need to run a quantization profile. estimate: 1 week to validate tokenizer and generate a 4-bit qprofile; another 1-2 weeks to perf-tune kernels and run perf matrix for ctx up to 1024. if we hit suboptimal attention patterns might need deeper ops work.
Sasha (Support): CoreFin is enterprise — they will expect SLA and rollback plan. we should confirm fallback model for APAC (if unavailable) and a canary rollout approach.
Maya (PM): Proposed launch criteria (draft):
- artifacts + checksum verified by catalog
- tokenizer parity confirmed (matching token counts on eval set)
- p95 latency <= 350ms for ctx512 on hosted config (default batch policy)
- quality regression < 2% on customer eval set vs baseline
- region gating plan for APAC if export control blocks weights
- Customer acceptance test (CAT) completed in staging
If we agree, we'll triage to backlog and scope the work.
Debbie (Catalog): legal flagged potential export controls for some weight transforms. we should mark APAC as blocked until compliance clears. EU + IN OK for now.
Ronan (Eng): technical note: for pinned v1.2.0 we'll also produce a quantized variant (`panthera-7b-v1.2.0-q4`) and an FP16 fallback. recommend we publish both into the catalog with a routing policy: prefer q4 for cost, fallback to fp16 for edge cases.
Alex (Sales): customer asked explicitly for pinned v1.2.0. can we commit to that?
Ronan (Eng): yes we can pin v1.2.0, but we should keep the catalog mapping to include the quantized artifact and a documented fallback. pin means traffic routes to that model id and we only change with explicit rollout.
Maya (PM): OK — action items:
- @Debbie: verify artifacts + license + checksum (due: 3 business days)
- @Ronan: tokenizer parity + qprofile bench (due: 7 business days)
- @Sasha: prepare CANARY and rollback playbook, SLA mapping (due: 5 business days)
- @Alex: confirm pilot date with CoreFin and whether they need on-prem images (due: EOD)
- I'll create PROD backlog ticket and link the intake.
ops-bot: catalog intake submitted for COREFIN-PA7B by Alex. ticket PROD-1023 created and assigned to Maya.
Sasha (Support): noted. will add a runbook template and recovery steps to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
Debbie (Catalog): found small mismatch in tokenizer file — will re-request artifact from CoreFin and confirm checksum. changing ETA: +2 days.
Maya (PM): noted delay. keeping EU + IN target — APAC blocked pending legal.
Alex (Sales): i'll ping the customer and ask for corrected tokenizer artifact and firm pilot date. will update this thread.
Ronan (Eng): flag: if tokenizer change is large we may need to re-run eval — that could add 1 week. will keep parallel work on perf kernels.
Maya (PM): thanks team. i'll update PROD-1023 with these scope items and the draft launch criteria. next sync in two days unless we get the artifact sooner. :calendar:
